```{r}
#2: Analysis
#=====================================================================================
#get cell values for 2x2 tables
# N: total number of human genes in genome
# N0_: unique number of genes per chemical
# N_0: unique number of genes related to ER stress
# a: number of genes related to ER and Chem for each chemical
# b: For each chemical: number of genes associated with chemical only
# c: for each chemical: number of genes associated with chemical only
# d: For each chemical: number of genes not associated with either chemical or ER
#=====================================================================================

#---------------------------------------------------------
#N: count number of genes in human genome list
#save as value 
#N <- length(unique(HU$Hum))
N <- length(HU$Hum)

#---------------------------------------------------------
#N0_: count total number of unique gene_symbols per chem 
#save as matrix use for margin count
uniq.chem <- 
  do.call(rbind, 
          lapply(CG, function(x) length(unique(x$gene_symbol))))

N0_ <- uniq.chem





#---------------------------------------------------------
#N_0: count number of DIS genes & save as list 
N_0 <- length(DIS$Gene.symbol)



#---------------------------------------------------------
#a: count number of genes related to DIS and Chem for each chemical
a <- sapply(CG, function(x) sum(x$gene_symbol %in% DIS$Gene.symbol)); a<-as.matrix(a, ncol=1)



#---------------------------------------------------------
#Get cell/margin counts using values obtained above
b = N0_ - a;
c = N_0 - a;
d = N-a-b-c;
N1_ = N - N0_; 
N_1 = N - N_0;


#---------------------------------------------------------
#Hum_t: 2x2 tables for all chemicals stored as list of dfs
# 1: save empty list for the information to go into 
# 2: combine all cell values by chemical
#-------------
# What the code is doing: 
#   For each item in the length of the chemical gene list 
#   combine cell values by row (chemical name) and create 
#   individual matrix for each chemical w/ 3 columns &
#   3 rows. Name each row and column to have appropriate 
#   titles save that whole thing as a list of data frames. 
#---------------------------------------------------------

Hum_t <- list()
for (i in 1:length(CG)) {
  
  Hum_t[[i]] <- matrix(c(a[i], b[i], N0_[1], 
                         c[i], d[i], N1_[1], 
                         N_0,  N_1,  N), ncol=3, byrow=T)
  
  rownames(Hum_t[[i]]) <- c("Yes","No","Total")
  colnames(Hum_t[[i]]) <- c("Yes","No","Total")
  
  Hum_t[[i]] <- as.data.frame(Hum_t[[i]])
}

#save names to match chem list 
names(Hum_t) <- names(CG)

```

# prep for fishers test: laplace rule of succession

## check for any 2x2 table with a 0 cell, add 1 to all cells

```{r}

for(i in 1:length(Hum_t)) {
  obj <- Hum_t[[i]]
  
  if(obj[1,1] == 0 | obj[1,2] == 0 | obj[2,1] == 0 | obj[2,2] == 0)
    
    Hum_t[[i]] <- obj+ 1
}


```

```{r}
#===============================================================================
#4: Fishers exact test
#===============================================================================
# Fisher test
fisher <- lapply(Hum_t, function(x) fisher.test(x[1:2,1:2], simulate.p.value = TRUE))
f <- data.frame(matrix(unlist(fisher), nrow=1008, byrow=TRUE),stringsAsFactors=FALSE) 


#fix names names
row.names(f) <- names(Hum_t)
names(f)[1] <- "fisher_pvalue"
names(f)[2] <- "fisher_LCI"
names(f)[3] <- "fisher_UCI"
names(f)[4] <- "fisher_estimate"

#restrict 
f<- select(f, 1:4)

#FDR correction
f$fisher_FDR <- p.adjust(f$fisher_pvalue, method="fdr")


```

```{r}
#===============================================================================
#5: Proportional reporting ratio (PRR)
#===============================================================================
# PRR matrix, containing PRR values, lower bounds and upper bounds
PRR <- as.data.frame(sapply(Hum_t, function(x) {
  PRR <- (x[1,1]/x[1,3])/(x[2,1]/x[2,3])
  s <- sqrt(1/x[1,1] + 1/x[2,1] - 
              1/(x[1,1]+x[1,2])   - 
              1/(x[2,1]+x[2,2]))
  prr.low <- PRR/exp(1.96*s)
  prr.up  <- PRR*exp(1.96*s)
  
  PRR <- rbind(PRR, s, prr.low, prr.up)
}))

# extract PRR values
prr<- t(PRR)
colnames(prr)<- c("prr", "s", "prr_LCI", "prr_UCI")


```

```{r}
#===============================================================================
#6: Summary result tables
#===============================================================================
#Extract Number of genes annotated per chemical for result table
df<-lapply(CG, function(x) nrow(x))
df<-unlist(df)
df1<- as.data.frame(df)
names(df1)[1]<- "genes_annotated_per_chem"
rm(df)


#compile 
sum_table<- cbind.data.frame(df1, a, f, prr)


sum_table<-sum_table %>% 
  mutate(chemical_name = row.names(sum_table)) %>%
  select(chemical_name, everything())
```
